name: Unblock Codex Prompt
description: Maintain an agent-scoped fleet prompt for Codex (model_instructions_file) and Claude CLI (guarded OpenClaw prompt assembly).

agentId.label: OpenClaw agent ID
agentId.help: Only this agent's prompt is managed; on Claude CLI only its runs through the claude-cli backend. Defaults to main.

agentName.label: Legacy agent name (unused)
agentName.help: Accepted for existing configs only. Identity comes from agent documents; shared prompt text comes only from promptUrl.

frozenContext.label: Managed prompt bridge
frozenContext.help: Required: true. Codex: replaces base instructions and OpenClaw generic policy on reviewed OpenClaw/Codex >=2026.10.5 layouts. Claude CLI: replaces only OpenClaw's generic policy on reviewed OpenClaw core layouts (2026.10.6-2026.10.9) and needs hooks.allowConversationAccess for its adoption gate. Runtimes come from the agent's configured model policy at explicit sync. SOUL, IDENTITY, USER and AGENTS stay live.

promptUrl.label: Fleet prompt endpoint
promptUrl.help: Required public HTTPS plain-text endpoint with X-Prompt-Revision SHA-256. The only shared-policy source. After initial sync, refreshed daily and when overdue on startup without refreshing agent context. No bundled prompt fallback.

suppressExplicitDelegationPrompt.label: Compact managed Codex instructions
suppressExplicitDelegationPrompt.help: Manage a model_catalog_json override: suppress explicit-only delegation and Default-mode prose, trim role introductions and compact full-access/never-approval text. Runtime mechanics and permissions are unchanged. Refreshed daily from the configured provider. Requires frozenContext and an available provider env_key. Generated-file edits are replaced on refresh.

disabledCodexSkills.label: Codex skills to remove
disabledCodexSkills.help: Plugin names (all of their skills) or exact skill names to disable in Codex's native skills list. Defaults to ChatGPT Pages and Pets. Applied through a managed [[skills.config]] block at startup, sync and daily refresh; other skills are untouched. Set [] to stop managing Codex skills.
